key_points: This document contains the notes for the release 3.1.3 of `rippled` , the reference server implementation of the XRP Ledger protocol.
Ripple has rotated the GPG key used to sign `rippled` packages.
If you have an existing installation, you should download and trust the new key to prevent issues upgrading in the future.
Automatic upgrades will not work until you have trusted the new key.
limitations: Ripple urges researchers to responsibly disclose any issues they may find.
asserts: Ripple has rotated the GPG key used to sign `rippled` packages and users should update their trust in the new key.
